N04#1.zh: 死秃驴，连你爷爷『小霸王』周通都敢打！看我放火一把烧了村子！
N04#1.t: Damn bald donkey, you dare hit your grandpa, the 'Little King' Zhou Tong? I'll burn this village to the ground!

N04#2.zh: 我佛慈悲，施主若是火烧桃花村，洒家一定三拳拆了你的山寨！
N04#2.t: Buddha is merciful. If you burn Peach Blossom Village, I'll tear down your stronghold with three punches!

N04#3.zh: 小子们！给我围起来！他们没有多少人，全部给我捉起来！尤其是那个胖和尚，我要亲手把他打得『一佛出世，二佛升天』！
N04#3.t: Lads! Surround them! There aren't many of them. Capture them all! Especially that fat monk. I'll beat him myself until 'one Buddha is born and a second ascends to heaven'!

N04#5.zh: 胜利条件   --- 打败周通

N04#7.zh: 限制回合数已到，未完成任务，游戏失败！

N04#8.zh: %N死亡之后，一干人为周通所擒伏，一把大火更将桃花村化为灰烬；鲁智深为周通所杀，史进、朱武等人回到少华山，继续过着打家劫舍的日子。一年后，在一场官府的大规模围剿行动之中，山寨被毁，史、朱等人也随之不知去向........
N04#8.t: After %N died, the whole group was captured by Zhou Tong, and a great fire burned Peach Blossom Village to ashes. Lu Zhishen was killed by Zhou Tong; Shi Jin, Zhu Wu and the others returned to Mount Shaohua and went on raiding. A year later, in a great government sweep, the stronghold was destroyed, and Shi, Zhu and the rest vanished without a trace........
